evidence_rule: Forecasts and outcomes quoted from named repo files; miss_ratio = measured/forecast in the forecast's own unit; null where sign flipped or no numeric forecast.

categories.UNMEASURED_PREREQUISITE: Plan sized a pool without checking the gates an order must pass first (status, held text, custody, citable ending instrument, current predicate).
categories.INVENTED_RATE: A hit rate, saving share or minutes figure was assumed, not measured.
categories.SELECTION_BIAS: Rates measured on the easiest family/pilot (Codification revocation swarm, X1's 10% eligible) were transferred to a harder population.
categories.PROXY_UNIT: Success counted in a proxy (payload tokens, bytes, packets, agent-minutes, certificates) instead of ready orders or billed $.
categories.COST_SHIFT: Producer savings were eaten by review, correction or new contrary-source research.
categories.ASSUMED_INDEPENDENCE: Steps or source lists treated as independent when they are gated or dependent.
categories.ACCESS_ASSUMPTION: Source access assumed (robots, Cloudflare, permissions, host routes) before a one-request check.
categories.REVIEW_LENIENCY: Pass rests on a reviewer from the same model family / single pass; quality rate not independently measured.
categories.UNCONSIDERED_ROUTE: Pessimistic miss: a cheaper route (archive mirror, script) was not in the plan.
categories.POLICY_COUNTED_UNAPPROVED: Saving counted from a policy change the owner had not approved.
